evidence.sent: Following Ramesh Traders v. Kavita Builders, [1963] 3 SCR 515, actual loss must be shown before forfeiture.
The ratio in Ramesh Traders v. Kavita Builders, [1963] 3 SCR 515 is distinguishable as the deposit here was nominal.
Relying on Ramesh Traders v. Kavita Builders, [1963] 3 SCR 515, the landlord must prove loss.
We follow the principle in Ramesh Traders v. Kavita Builders, [1963] 3 SCR 515.
Sunder Lal v. State of Mysore, [1971] 2 SCR 40 is overruled; a fee need not be matched by a specific service.
